description: This file contains the source code for the 'Mail' class within the Opencart system. It implements a basic PHP mail class capable of sending emails with options for HTML content, attachments, and custom headers. The class provides methods to construct email messages and send them via PHP's mail function, supporting multipart MIME types and various email components.

classes.name: Mail
classes.description: A class for composing and sending emails with support for attachments, HTML content, and custom headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Mail object with optional configuration options.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Composes and sends an email based on the provided options and content.
